findings.text: _station_live_work_verdict is the only path that delivers this node's benefit, yet every case in tests/test_a_session_host_reads_the_stations_live_work.py monkeypatches it (lines 125 and 162); a regression in the read-only sqlite statement at line 459 (a changed station key, DATABASE_NAME or URI) makes it answer None, the host silently reverts to classifying every pointer -- the exact cost this node exists to remove -- and all three tests stay green.

the store root is resolved through station_store.runtime_root_source() from the process environment (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, /run/user/<uid>, TMPDIR) rather than through RECKON_HOME, so callers used by existing tests now read node-global state outside the repository under test: tests/test_a_settled_follower_rearms_while_its_session_owns_work.py:229 asserts live_work_run(...) == WORKING_RUN, which a fresh station reading for a project literally named 'proj' would flip with no code change.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; the single commit 32b5ddf2 changes four files, moving the payload reading out of station_subscriber.live_work_verdict into live_work_verdict_from_payload (a verbatim extract, no behaviour change), adding LiveWorkAnswer, live_work_answer and _station_live_work_verdict in session_host.py, and adding live_work_source to the census entry.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_session_host_reads_the_stations_live_work.py; its three cases cover the three stated conditions (lines 130-139 for a fresh reading naming the session, 151-155 for a fresh reading not naming it, 179-184 for the stale fallback with the census naming it), and the worker's gate.log records 3 passed with a closing EXIT=0 at revision 32b5ddf2.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a session host answer a settled pair's live work from the station's fresh reading and classify no pointer, falling back to its own judgement when the reading is stale or missing; reckon/crew/session_host.py:480-495 implements exactly that through live_work_answer, and line 1139 records which reader re-armed the pair.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the commit, the gate command with 3 passed, the base and head arm logs at 1 failed / 422 passed each with the same pre-existing preparation.py module-limit failure id, and the negative-control log path alone on its line; it omits the structured baseline_suite/after_suite keys, so the arm figures come from the logs named on line 14 rather than from those keys.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares the two modules, the two test files, the evidence fragment and the figure; the delivered diff bd0d2051..32b5ddf2 touches reckon/crew/session_host.py, reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py and the two declared test files, and nothing else.

SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: live_work_answer at reckon/crew/session_host.py:480 answers from the station reading while it is fresh (owed=True/False with no pointer read) and falls through to _classified_live_work only when the verdict is None, and line 1139 writes the answering source into the census.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the gate names tests/test_a_session_host_reads_the_stations_live_work.py and gate.log records 3 passed / EXIT=0 at 32b5ddf2, while base-arm.log and head-arm.log each record 1 failed, 422 passed, the same test_every_concern_fits_the_module_limit id, so zero failures are added.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff --name-only bd0d2051..32b5ddf2 lists exactly the four declared paths, session_host.py, station_subscriber.py and the two test files, with no plan, index or unrelated edit.
SCORE durability: 12
JUSTIFICATION durability: the three cases genuinely fail if the host stops consulting the station (negative-control.log shows all three red at the base revision), but every case monkeypatches _station_live_work_verdict at lines 125 and 162, so the station-reading adapter at reckon/crew/session_host.py:425 has no guard.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change follows the module's idiom of frozen dataclasses, module-level source constants and lazy imports, and adds no plan label, ticket id or author attribution at reckon/crew/session_host.py:409-495.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: live_work_verdict_from_payload at reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:463 is extracted from the existing live_work_verdict so the host reuses the one statement of payload reading; no owner of a generic read-only station reader exists (obligation_snapshot.py:587 and open_run_index.py:196 read other keys), so the direct read at session_host.py:459 has no owner to extend.
FINDING reckon/crew/session_host.py:425 non-blocking: _station_live_work_verdict is the only path that delivers this node's benefit, yet every case in tests/test_a_session_host_reads_the_stations_live_work.py monkeypatches it (lines 125 and 162); a regression in the read-only sqlite statement at line 459 (a changed station key, DATABASE_NAME or URI) makes it answer None, the host silently reverts to classifying every pointer -- the exact cost this node exists to remove -- and all three tests stay green.
FINDING reckon/crew/session_host.py:445 non-blocking: the store root is resolved through station_store.runtime_root_source() from the process environment (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, /run/user/<uid>, TMPDIR) rather than through RECKON_HOME, so callers used by existing tests now read node-global state outside the repository under test: tests/test_a_settled_follower_rearms_while_its_session_owns_work.py:229 asserts live_work_run(...) == WORKING_RUN, which a fresh station reading for a project literally named 'proj' would flip with no code change.
